title: Experiment 2: drift (policy change mid-stream, changing review rate)
description:
## Note

Experiment 2 (after experiment 1 is published, and only if E >> L and X): drift. A policy change mid-stream (the SME's written policy changes at a known point) and a changing review rate p over time. Measure how fast each arm recovers after the change and whether stale few-shot examples/questions are retired.

Not planned in detail; no spend. Plan separately with the owner.
